recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless a future issue decides to change the ServiceRequest.code binding itself or create a replacement LOINC order value set.
issue_request: The Applied/Persuasive with Modification issue reported that IG Publisher output exposed an invalid markdown link in the ServiceRequest.code binding description, specifically the text pointing to valueset-diagnostic-requests.html, and the approved resolution was to remove that unsupported value-set-link text.
initial_application: Git commit e3a4c4f4e1cb80cd9bd88481028e0d7b9df9f88c applied FHIR-41553 by editing source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml to remove the fragment saying a LOINC Order-code value set was available at valueset-diagnostic-requests.html.
additional_context: ServiceRequest is active in source/fhir.ini, the current ServiceRequest.code binding description keeps the valid LOINC preferred statement and Procedure Codes example binding, and the Zulip and OO minutes evidence confirms the issue was a spec metadata link problem rather than a broader binding change.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed because the active StructureDefinition source no longer contains the broken diagnostic-requests link or the obsolete available-here wording.
